issues.title: Selected date not highlighted
issues.description: The calendar grid does not render an active state for the selected date.
issues.evidence: The footer states Jan 12, 2026 is selected, but day 12 displays resting state styling.
issues.suggestion: Apply active background and border tokens to the selected CalendarDayButton.
issues.triageNote: Real defect, but root cause was not subtle dark bg-primary: react-day-picker v9 dropped the uncontrolled defaultSelected prop, so defaultSelected never rendered any selection (bg-primary is near-white in dark and clearly visible once selected state exists). Fixed in calendar.tsx by emulating uncontrolled defaultSelected with internal state.

issues.title: Low contrast for muted calendar dates
issues.description: Muted date numbers have insufficient contrast against the dark surface background.
issues.evidence: Date digits in the top row and day 7 blend into the dark calendar background.
issues.suggestion: Increase the foreground luminance for muted calendar day tokens.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: disabled days were double-dimmed — td got opacity-50 from the disabled classNames AND the Button base added disabled:opacity-50 (~1.4:1 on dark background). Removed opacity-50 from the disabled classNames and added disabled:opacity-100 to CalendarDayButton so muted digits render at full text-muted-foreground (~5.8:1 in dark).

issues.title: Unmirrored calendar navigation in RTL
issues.description: Month navigation chevrons remain in standard LTR orientation rather than RTL.
issues.evidence: Previous and next chevrons are placed on the left and right respectively.
issues.suggestion: Swap navigation arrow directions to follow RTL flow.
issues.triageNote: rtl:**:[.rdp-button\_next>svg]:rotate-180 / previous rules were already present in HEAD and verified in compiled CSS; under dir=rtl the nav flex reverses (previous right, next left) and both chevrons rotate 180, giving a correct mirror — which for symmetric chevrons is visually identical to the LTR layout the auditor misread as unmirrored.
